text:
This report is part of the Work and Opportunities for Women (WOW) programme.

This document provides a practical tool for effective planning to ensure that economic inclusion is meaningfully integrated across all different stages of the programme cycle.

The 3 levels of ambition provided are:

minimum standard

empowerment

transformation

The different programme stages are:

business case and programme design

mobilisation/procurement

programme implementation

monitoring, evaluation and learning (MEL)

programme completion
